description: Resume nearest QKV unions after excluding its first scored-sensitive pair
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,687 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 33 prior macro-attempts and 428 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0089/micro-0008 at 1,687 parameters and 99.01%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0090/micro-0001, whose revised token union scored 0.77%. At the QKV site, attempt-0089/micro-0009's (516,694) union scored 98.99%. Hypothesis: the first QKV failure is coordinate-specific rather than a global attention-difference boundary; excluding exactly that pair and resuming ascending current QKV-group difference can find a neutral alternative. This parameterization-preserving compression is more informative than further token exclusions because token alternatives now show a sharp repeated failure, whereas QKV has only one scored boundary after 48 accepted unions. Each micro-trial adds one eligible QKV union and the official runner alone accepts or rolls back. Stop on the first scored discard or error, at 20 micro-trials, or if no pair remains. Compute budget: at most 20 checkpoint migrations and official verifications or 30 wall-clock minutes.
summary: The revised QKV branch evaluated two eligible alternatives. The first qualified at 1,686 parameters and exactly 99.00% and was retained; the second proposed 1,685 parameters and scored 98.99%, so it was discarded and rolled back. Frontier moved from 1,687 to 1,686 parameters; 1 accept, 1 scored discard, 0 errors. Compute used two checkpoint migrations and two official verifications over 2m26s wall clock. Stop reason: first scored failure closed the revised QKV path before the 20-trial/30-minute cap.
